app.title: The simplest way to rent a power bank
app.sub: Find a station on the map, scan and rent in seconds, follow your rental and return at any station. And the first hour? On us, when you download the app.
app.swipe: Swipe to see all the screens

shots.title: Find a station nearby
shots.text: A map of the stations around you and the way to the closest one. No more panic-hunting for an outlet.
shots.alt: The FULLIN app map screen: a map of Tel Aviv with station pins and a scan button

shots.title: Scan and rent in seconds
shots.text: The station card shows how many power banks are available and how many slots are free for returns, then you tap to rent.
shots.alt: A station card in the app: available power banks, free return slots, rent and navigate buttons

shots.title: Return at any station
shots.text: When you finish you get a summary with the rental time and the return location, and billing stops.
shots.alt: The rental complete screen: a check mark, rental time, return location and a star rating

features.title: Simplest
features.text: Map, scan, power bank in hand. No forms, no searching.

features.title: Follow your rental
features.text: See your rental in one place, and get a summary with the rental time and return location when it ends.

features.title: Return anywhere
features.text: No need to go back to the same station. Any FULLIN station takes the power bank.

features.title: In four languages
features.text: Hebrew, English, Arabic and Russian. The battery may run out, but never the words.

pay.title: Pay your way
pay.text: Scan the QR on the station and pay on a secure payment page, even without the app. ₪12 per hour from the first minute.
pay.rates: After the first hour: ₪12 per hour, capped at ₪50 per day. No hidden fees.

dl.title: Get the app
dl.noapp: No app? You can still rent by scanning the QR on the station, at ₪12 per hour from the first minute.
